phenomenon: two unrelated constructions coexist, one with an optional slot, alongside opaque indices that reuse both surface pieces
notes: Three things at once. (1) ACTION+FACE and OPERATOR+COUNT are genuinely distinct constructions: neither class sequence is a subsequence of the other, so they must not be fused by shared left-edge position. (2) chN10 and wmS30 add an optional DURATION to the ACTION+FACE family; that is ONE construction with an optional slot, not a separate three-slot construction, so gold and prediction alike are expected to carry two templates after merging. (3) S1/S2 are opaque symptom indices whose S is homographic with the FACE morpheme S and whose digits look like the COUNT class -- both pieces are live morphemes elsewhere in this very codebook, and both must still be refused here.

codebook.chN10: chime on the front face for ten seconds
codebook.wmS30: warm the back face for thirty seconds
codebook.x2: repeat the previous step two times
codebook.x4: repeat the previous step four times
codebook.x6: repeat the previous step six times
codebook.S1: symptom: hairline crack near the seam
